name: fabrica-skills
description: Agent-readable markdown skills for turning raw product ideas into small working apps

scripts.validate: npm run validate:run-pass && npm run validate:run-fail && npm run validate:run-gate-fail && npm run validate:manifest
scripts.test: node test/validate-run.test.mjs && node test/sync-manifest.test.mjs && node test/link-skills.test.mjs && node test/skill-gates.test.mjs && node test/verification-kind.test.mjs && node test/docs.test.mjs && node test/install-cli.test.mjs && node test/migrate-run-skill-ids.test.mjs
scripts.lint: eslint --ext .js,.mjs scripts/ test/ bin/ && prettier --check scripts/ test/ bin/
scripts.lint:fix: eslint --ext .js,.mjs --fix scripts/ test/ bin/ && prettier --write scripts/ test/ bin/
scripts.check: npm run validate && npm test && npm run lint
